titles.en: Stele of the Yan Family Shrine, original stone

dimensions.note: The museum gives the height only. Width, thickness and the dimensions of the head and base are not stated on the cited page.

currentCollection.note: The museum's entry describes the stele as held at the Xi'an Beilin Museum and among the earliest stones moved to the present site. It does not give a hall or a display status.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方条目记此碑藏西安碑林博物馆，且为移入今址最早的碑石之一。未记陈列殿堂与展出状态。

provenanceEvents.summary: After the stone had fallen in open country, it was moved into the prefectural Confucian temple and re-erected; the Song colophon under the first line records this.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 碑先仆于郊野，此年移入京兆府文庙重立；碑阳首行题下宋人题记记其事。

review.note: Draft object record from the museum's entry read on 2026-11-23. Height and the 982 re-erection come from that page; the page did not respond to a later request, and the stone was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的馆方条目整理。碑高与 982 年重立出自该页；该页稍后再请求未通，未核对原石。

notes: The stele is inscribed on both faces and both sides; this record treats it as one object, not four.
The record does not state whether the stone is complete: the museum describes it as surviving and gives no loss or repair.
notesZh: 此碑两面两侧俱刻；本记录作一件实物，不作四件。
本记录不主张完缺：馆方只称存世，未记残损或修补。
